November 2026

Shelter at 2811 SE 29th St. Adoptions Tue-Sat noon-5pm. A Nov 9, 2026 city bulletin says the shelter moves to the new Louisa McCune Animal Welfare Center in mid-December 2026. The programs page (checked Nov 26, 2026) lists Foster-to-Adopt, Pets in Foster Homes and volunteering, but no day-out or holiday flash-foster program yet. The 2025 'Home for the Holidays' flash foster has not been confirmed for 2026, so re-check in December. Phone 405-297-3100.
